model_annotation: This donut chart visually represents two categorical distributions: the outer ring shows the distribution of standard deviation values for ambiguity, with four segments labeled “Std: 0.0” (dark blue, 49.0%), “Std: 0.47” (medium blue, 47.7%), “Std: 0.82” (light blue, 7.0%), and “Std: 0.94” (very light blue, 5.0%); the inner ring shows the distribution of maximum ambiguity values, with three segments labeled “Max: 1” (dark blue, 38.0%), “Max: 2” (medium blue, 39.0%), and “Max: 3” (light blue, 14.2%). The chart includes two legends: one for the outer ring labeled “Ambiguity Std (Outer)” and one for the inner ring labeled “Max Ambiguity (Inner)”. Percentage values are displayed directly within each segment of both rings, and the segments are color-coded according to their respective categories as defined in the legends. The outer ring segments are arranged clockwise from top-left, while the inner ring segments follow a similar clockwise arrangement starting from the bottom-left.
